title: weave-record/1 reference
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for the reference object used by refs, labels.consent, actor.grant and kind bodies. Hints are discovery aids only and never carry identity.

digest.title: reference digest
digest.description: Digest string of the referenced record: <algorithm>:<lowercase hex>. H0 checks sha256 strictly (exactly 64 lowercase hex characters). Any other syntactically well-formed algorithm token is structurally valid but unsupported, so the reference resolves to unverifiable instead of producing a record error; unknown-algorithm entries are ignored semantically. Container positions, by contrast, require sha256.
